error_reason: The Planner agent repeatedly instructed the WebSurfer to search for the exact same query ('Lake Louisvilla Oldham County population location') across multiple turns (Turns 5, 7, 9, 11, 14). Despite the WebSurfer returning identical results (browser upgrade pages) in each instance, the Planner failed to recognize this loop, did not vary the search strategy, and did not conclude that further web searching was futile. This rigid repetition of steps without adaptation constitutes step_repetition.

suggested_fix.fix_text: Before executing a web search, explicitly check if the last 3 search queries were identical. If so, terminate the search loop and synthesize a final answer based on accumulated evidence, rather than repeating the query.

The reasoning clearly links the repeated identical queries to the failure mode. Fixing this would likely have led to a rapid termination of the search loop and a better synthesis of the location data vs. population data discrepancy.
